references.text: Psalm 107:4 speaks of wandering in the wilderness, a metaphor that can be linked to following Jesus in Mark 1:17.
Isaiah 6:1 calls for service, which resonates with the call to discipleship in Mark 1:17.
Matthew 4:19-20 is the parallel to Mark 1:17 where Jesus calls his first disciples with similar words.
Luke 5:10-11 gives a similar account to Mark 1:17 about Jesus' call to discipleship.
